seo.title: Wellness in Zagorje | Saunas & Whirlpool – Hotel Zagi
seo.description: A new wellness centre in Oroslavje near Zagreb: Finnish, bio and infrared saunas with a Himalayan salt wall, a whirlpool, an ice fountain and a relax zone.

hero.title: Wellness like a dream in the heart of Zagorje
hero.lead: Relax your mind and body, de-stress and renew your energy.

quote: Imagine a place where time stands still.

intro.heading: A place where time stands still
paragraphs: …where every step leads deeper into calm, and every breath brings relief.
…where the warmth of the sauna holds you like an embrace, and the scent of Himalayan salt awakens the energy sleeping in your body.
…where water dances on your skin, washing away the traces of stress, and silence says more than words.

saunasIntro.heading: Three saunas, three ways to unwind
saunasIntro.lead: A gentle bio sauna, an infrared sauna with a Himalayan salt wall and a classic Finnish sauna.

facilities.name: Bio sauna
facilities.tagline: Gentle warmth and the scent of essential oils
paragraphs: The pleasant temperature and moderate humidity of the bio sauna create an especially gentle climate for relaxation and well-being. The warmth relaxes the muscles and does the body good.

A special humidifier releases steam into the sauna, enriched with the scent of essential oils, which helps cleanse the skin and airways. For the full effect, we recommend breathing deeply and steadily.

image.alt: Wooden bio sauna with benches, a water bucket and warm lighting

facilities.name: Infrared sauna with a Himalayan salt wall
paragraphs: Infrared heaters warm a smaller space, and the infrared warmth gently penetrates deep into the tissue throughout the body, helping it release the toxins that weigh it down.

The Himalayan salt wall enriches the air with beneficial negative salt ions. According to our brochure, they help cleanse the body, have antibacterial properties and bring relief with respiratory complaints, sore throats and sinus problems, headaches, skin problems and rheumatism.

image.alt: Infrared sauna with an illuminated Himalayan salt wall and wooden benches

facilities.name: Finnish sauna
facilities.tagline: A classic for body and mind
paragraphs: The Finnish sauna is excellent for relaxing the muscles, cleansing the body, strengthening its resistance and refreshing the mind.
After the Finnish sauna, cool down with cold water from the bucket or in the shower, then apply ice to any areas of the body that need extra stimulation.

image.alt: Spacious Finnish sauna with tiered wooden benches

facilities.name: Whirlpool with air and water massage
paragraphs: Warm water with air and water massage for complete relaxation – surrounded by candles, greenery and soft light.
